headline: Trusted numbers first, then action before Go Big
annotation: Every segment and list ships with a holdout to prove impact.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: Here is my answer: five priorities, in three moves.

Clarity first. P1 is one metric truth for the North Star, SoW and CM3, readable by people and by AI. P2 measures how much of the level drops is balance noise and gives the concept council evidence to fix the rules.
Learn. P3 finds out why the pilot got twice the results, ready in December so it shapes Go Big.
Equip. P4 gives squads and campaigns data-driven segments for Go Big, and P5 gives bankers a weekly list of clients about to drop a level or move money out.
Everything lands before Go Big, and every segment and list carries a holdout group, so we prove impact from the first day. Brain and personas build on top of this.
